game-start.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the match of the century! Messi versus Cristiano — The Last Dance! The referee blows the whistle, and we are underway!
This is it! The moment the whole world has been waiting for! Messi and Ronaldo, face to face, one last time. The whistle goes — let the battle begin!
The stadium is electric! Two legends, one final showdown! Messi versus Cristiano — The Last Dance begins NOW!

goal-messi.text: GOOOOOL! MESSI! LIONEL MESSI SCORES! The little magician has done it again! Absolute brilliance! The crowd goes wild!
HE'S DONE IT! MESSIII! A touch of genius from the Argentine wizard! Nobody can stop this man! WHAT A GOAL!
MESSI SCORES! OH MY! THE GOAT STRIKES AGAIN! You just cannot write a better script than this! Incredible!

goal-cristiano.text: GOOOOOL! CRISTIANO RONALDO! WHAT A STRIKE! The man is simply unstoppable! SIUUUU! The fans are on their feet!
RONALDOOO! HE SMASHES IT IN! The power, the precision, the celebration! CR7 is built for these moments! SIUUU!
HE SCORES! CRISTIANO RONALDO! The machine does it again! Cold, clinical, devastating! Nobody does it like him!

game-over-messi.text: And that is it! The final whistle blows! Messi wins The Last Dance! The greatest of all time has proven it once again on the biggest stage! What a match, what a night!
It's all over! Lionel Messi takes the crown! The little genius from Rosario has done what he does best — make the impossible look easy. Messi wins!
The Last Dance belongs to Messi! A performance for the ages! Years from now, people will talk about this night. Leo Messi — champion once more!

game-over-cristiano.text: It's over! Cristiano Ronaldo wins The Last Dance! The machine, the legend, has conquered this historic showdown! An unforgettable performance from CR7!
Cristiano Ronaldo has done it! The man who refuses to lose! Through sheer will and power, CR7 claims victory in The Last Dance!
The king has spoken! Ronaldo wins The Last Dance! A legacy cemented in gold! This man simply does not know how to quit!

fun-fact.text: Did you know? Messi and Ronaldo have scored over 1,700 career goals combined. Absolutely staggering numbers.
These two have dominated football for nearly two decades. We may never see a rivalry like this again.
The tension in this stadium is unbelievable. Every touch, every pass — it all matters. This is what football is all about.
